steps: Users route to a nearby healthy region.
Both regions accept writes under explicitly mergeable invariants.
Updates replicate across the high-latency inter-region link.
Concurrent versions resolve deterministically and regional failure shifts traffic.

lesson.scenario: Two regions accept shopping-cart writes while converging concurrent updates with explicit conflict semantics.

steps.title: Serve the nearest active region
steps.narration: The director chooses East US at 31 ms RTT while both regions are writable and healthy.
action: Send shopper S-77 to East US

steps.title: Merge domain operations
steps.narration: The resolver uses an observed-remove map: independent SKU operations merge, while per-SKU quantity uses the highest causal dot.
steps.outcome: No whole-cart last-writer overwrite loses an item.

steps.title: Verify regional convergence
steps.narration: Both regions store vector {81,20} and canonical cart checksum 91bc; traffic remains active in both.
steps.outcome: The cart converges after the partition heals.
